# Dilemma v3.8.0

Spend Sparks to gain EXP with `/dilemma score exchange`. One Spark gives 3 EXP, so `amount:10` gives 30 EXP. Purchased EXP counts toward levels and level badges. The leaderboard ranks quiz points. Each level-up awards 5 Sparks, and retrying the same successful exchange returns the original receipt.

`/dilemma random` now generates all answer options. Players still choose difficulty, 2-4 answers and voting duration. The bot rejects older custom-answer requests before reserving a random slot. Hints and betting work under the existing rules.

New servers start in English. The welcome menu and `/dilemma language` list English first and Polski second. The English and Polish player guides describe the exchange and updated random command.

Apply `20261109120000_sparks_experience_exchange` and re-register Discord commands when upgrading from v3.7.2. Existing quiz points retain their EXP value. Purchased EXP starts at zero.
